title: siem_pivot
description: Origin: v2 §18.4. The STABLE pivot field set every exported finding/observation carries, so an analyst can cross-reference the same event across SIEMs regardless of transport (CEF/CIM/ECS). Names here are CANONICAL; services/findings-forwarder/mappings.py renames them to Splunk CIM and Elastic/OpenSearch ECS. Every field is always present in the extractor output; a field with no value on the source finding is explicitly null (never omitted) so a pivot is either a link or a documented gap. file_artifact_id and investigation_id are produced by Track A / U9 and are null until then. Independently authored from open CIM/ECS references (§26 IP): no Corelight assets or wording.

finding_id.description: Stable finding OCCURRENCE identity (F13) — this specific export. The one pivot that is never null.

signature_id.description: Identity of the signature/detector that fired (detector_id), SHARED by every finding that detector emits — distinct from the per-occurrence finding_id. Null if the finding names no detector.

revision.description: Which revision of the finding this export is (R03) — distinguishes an enriched/timeout re-delivery from the original.

incident_id.description: The correlation incident this finding rolled into (correlation-service), or null if not correlated.

entity_id.description: Tenant-scoped entity spine key the finding attaches to (F08 entity_key), or null.

asset_key.description: Stable asset key surviving IP change (§15.5, U17), or null when the entity is a bare IP.

community_id.description: Community-ID flow hash (the cross-tool flow pivot), or null.

observation_point.description: The sensor that observed the flow (sensor_id), or null.

observation_id.description: The canonical observation id (obs_id) the finding drew from, or null.

pcap_evidence_id.description: Pointer to captured pcap/evidence (e.g. MinIO object), or null.

file_artifact_id.description: Extracted-file artifact id (Track A). Null until Track A produces it.

investigation_id.description: Investigation/case id (U9). Null until U9 produces it.

model_version.description: Detector model version (ML detectors), or null for rule-only detectors.
